description: Delete an inline comment thread from a Markdown document, which is how a thread is resolved in Text, or with reply one comment in it. The document text is kept.

commentId.description: Comment ID, such as comment-3 (from list_text_comments)

reply.description: Position of the one comment to delete (2 = first reply). 1 or omitted deletes the thread

name: delete_text_comment
title: Delete Text Comment
